---
title: "06 Supplementary Tables S1-S3"
author: "Shuai Guo"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

Assembles Supplementary Tables S1 to S3 of the Letter from the harmonised
metadata in `data/` and the tables already written by `01_four_groups.Rmd` and
`05_sensitivity.Rmd`. Nothing is re-estimated here: no test and no bootstrap is
run, so the tables reproduce the saved results exactly and this script can run
on its own once 01 and 05 have been run.

* **Table S1** cohort composition and endpoint-specific denominators
* **Table S2** sensitivity to hypermutated tumours (source: 05, section 1)
* **Table S3** reported race or ethnicity in the Western cohorts and sensitivity
  to the Western-group definition (source: 05, section 3; primary TMB and SBS4
  rows from section 1)

Each table is written to `results/supplementary_tables/` as a long CSV with one
table cell per line: `part` (A, B, C), `part_title`, the `row` and `column`
labels, and the `value`. The numbers are those printed in the Supporting
Information, but several labels are worded differently, mostly more fully (the
printed "Smoking group" row, for example, is "Population group and smoking
status" here). Table S1B adds the ever-smoker fractions quoted in the main text,
and Table S3A adds two columns that list the Asian or part-Asian and Other
tumours as reported; the printed tables omit both.

The metadata are read directly rather than through `load_metadata()`, because
Table S1B starts from all 1,467 harmonised tumours, before the reported-ancestry
and missing-smoking exclusions. The restricted in-house variant file
(`data/Guo2026_snv.csv`) is not needed here: the mutation-frequency denominators
in Table S1C follow the tumours used by 01, which include Guo2026 only when that
file was present when 01 was run.

```{r setup}
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

  dir.create("../results/supplementary_tables", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  cell_levels = c("EAS Never", "EAS Ever", "Western Never", "Western Ever")
  cohort_order = c("Guo2026", "Chen2019", "Chen2020", "Xu2020", "TCGA2014", "TRACERx2023")
  number_word = c("one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six")

  # Every tumour harmonised by 00, including the reported-Asian exclusions and
  # the tumours without recorded smoking status.
  meta_raw = read.csv("../data/analysis_metadata.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stopifnot(anyDuplicated(meta_raw$SampleID) == 0)

  # The primary analysis set, defined exactly as load_metadata() defines it.
  meta = meta_raw[!meta_raw$AncestryExcluded, ]
  meta = meta[!is.na(meta$Smoking), ]
  meta$Cell = factor(paste(meta$CohortGroup, meta$Smoking), levels = cell_levels)

  # One table cell per line.
  long_rows = function(part, part_title, row, column, value) {
    out = data.frame(part = part, part_title = part_title, row = row,
                     column = column, value = as.character(value),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    out
  }

  # Wide view of one part, for reading in the report only.
  show_part = function(tab, p) {
    d = tab[tab$part == p, c("row", "column", "value")]
    w = reshape(d, idvar = "row", timevar = "column", direction = "wide")
    names(w) = sub("^value\\.", "", names(w))
    rownames(w) = NULL
    w
  }

  # "A, B, C, and D"
  join_and = function(x) {
    if (length(x) == 1) {
      return(x)
    }
    paste0(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), ", and ", x[length(x)])
  }

  fmt_ci = function(lo, hi) {
    sprintf("%.3f to %.3f", lo, hi)
  }

  # The bootstrap P has a floor of 1/(n_boot + 1), 5.0e-4 with 2,000 resamples.
  fmt_p = function(p) {
    out = sprintf("%.3f", p)
    out[p < 5e-4] = "<5.0 x 10^-4"
    out
  }
```

# Table S1. Cohort composition and endpoint-specific denominators

## A. Tumours contributed by each cohort to the four analysis cells

Counted from the primary analysis set and checked against
`results/01_four_groups/tables/01_cell_counts.csv`, the source of Figure 1A.

```{r s1-a}
  title_a = "Tumors contributed by each cohort to the four analysis cells"
  cell_cols = c("EAS never-smoker", "EAS ever-smoker",
                "Western never-smoker", "Western ever-smoker")

  counts = table(factor(meta$Cohort, levels = cohort_order), meta$Cell)
  cell_counts = read.csv("../results/01_four_groups/tables/01_cell_counts.csv",
                         row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  stopifnot(all(as.matrix(cell_counts[cohort_order, cell_levels]) ==
                unclass(counts)[cohort_order, cell_levels]))

  s1 = NULL
  for (co in cohort_order) {
    label = co
    if (co == "Guo2026") {
      label = "Guo2026 (in-house)"
    }
    group = unique(meta$CohortGroup[meta$Cohort == co])
    s1 = rbind(s1, long_rows("A", title_a, label,
                             c("Group", cell_cols, "Total"),
                             c(group, counts[co, ], sum(counts[co, ]))))
  }
  s1 = rbind(s1, long_rows("A", title_a, "Total", c(cell_cols, "Total"),
                           c(colSums(counts), sum(counts))))
  show_part(s1, "A")
```

## B. Derivation of the primary analysis set

The reported-Asian exclusion is applied first and the missing-smoking exclusion
second; the two sets do not overlap.

```{r s1-b}
  title_b = "Derivation of the primary analysis set"

  n_raw = nrow(meta_raw)
  anc_out = meta_raw$AncestryExcluded
  smk_out = !anc_out & is.na(meta_raw$Smoking)
  anc_groups = unique(meta_raw$CohortGroup[anc_out])
  smk_cohorts = unique(meta_raw$Cohort[smk_out])
  stopifnot(n_raw - sum(anc_out) - sum(smk_out) == nrow(meta))

  n_cell = table(meta$Cell)
  cell_text = paste(n_cell, c("EAS never", "EAS ever", "Western never", "Western ever"))
  eas = meta$CohortGroup == "EAS"
  west = meta$CohortGroup == "Western"
  ever_eas = 100 * sum(meta$Smoking[eas] == "Ever") / sum(eas)
  ever_west = 100 * sum(meta$Smoking[west] == "Ever") / sum(west)

  s1 = rbind(s1, long_rows("B", title_b,
    paste("Harmonised across", number_word[length(unique(meta_raw$Cohort))], "cohorts"),
    c("Tumors", "Basis"), c(n_raw, "One tumor per patient")))
  s1 = rbind(s1, long_rows("B", title_b,
    paste("Excluded from", paste(anc_groups, collapse = ", "), "cohorts"),
    c("Tumors", "Basis"), c(-sum(anc_out), "Reported as Asian or part-Asian")))
  s1 = rbind(s1, long_rows("B", title_b,
    paste("Excluded from", paste(smk_cohorts, collapse = ", ")),
    c("Tumors", "Basis"), c(-sum(smk_out), "Smoking status not recorded")))
  s1 = rbind(s1, long_rows("B", title_b, "Primary analysis set",
    c("Tumors", "Basis"), c(nrow(meta), paste(cell_text, collapse = " / "))))
  s1 = rbind(s1, long_rows("B", title_b, "Ever-smoker fraction", "Basis",
    sprintf("%.1f%% in EAS; %.1f%% in Western", ever_eas, ever_west)))
  show_part(s1, "B")
```

## C. Endpoint-specific denominators

Each endpoint uses the tumours carrying the relevant data layer, as flagged in
the metadata by 00. The driver-panel size and the number of genes in the
genome-wide scan are read from the 01 tables.

```{r s1-c}
  title_c = "Endpoint-specific denominators"
  denom_cols = c("n", "EAS never", "EAS ever", "Western never", "Western ever",
                 "Cohorts contributing")

  # "All six", or e.g. "Five; Chen2019 excluded".
  cohorts_note = function(flag) {
    have = cohort_order[cohort_order %in% meta$Cohort[flag]]
    miss = setdiff(cohort_order, have)
    word = number_word[length(have)]
    if (length(miss) == 0) {
      return(paste("All", word))
    }
    word = paste0(toupper(substr(word, 1, 1)), substring(word, 2))
    paste0(word, "; ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "), " excluded")
  }

  freq = read.csv("../results/01_four_groups/tables/08_driver_frequency_by_cell.csv",
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  hits = read.csv("../results/01_four_groups/tables/07_driver_hit_counts.csv",
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  n_drivers = length(unique(freq$gene))
  n_scan = unique(hits$n_tested)
  stopifnot(length(n_scan) == 1)

  # 01 leaves Guo2026 out of the mutation-frequency analyses when the restricted
  # variant file is absent (load_metadata()); follow the tumours 01 used.
  has_maf = meta$HasFullMAF
  n_maf = freq[freq$gene == freq$gene[1], ]
  n_maf = n_maf$n[match(cell_levels, n_maf$Cell)]
  if (sum(n_maf) != sum(has_maf)) {
    has_maf[meta$Cohort == "Guo2026"] = FALSE
  }
  stopifnot(all(as.vector(table(meta$Cell[has_maf])) == n_maf))

  endpoints = c("Population group and smoking status",
                "Tumor mutation burden",
                paste0("Mutation-frequency analyses (", n_drivers, "-driver panel and ",
                       format(n_scan, big.mark = ","), "-gene scan)"),
                "Mutational-signature refit and substitution classes")
  flags = list(rep(TRUE, nrow(meta)), meta$HasTMB, has_maf, meta$HasSignature)
  for (i in seq_along(endpoints)) {
    f = flags[[i]]
    by_cell = table(meta$Cell[f])
    s1 = rbind(s1, long_rows("C", title_c, endpoints[i], denom_cols,
                             c(sum(f), by_cell[cell_levels], cohorts_note(f))))
  }

  per_cohort = cohort_order[cohort_order %in% meta$Cohort[meta$InPerCohortAnalysis]]
  s1 = rbind(s1, long_rows("C", title_c, "Within-cohort and cohort-pair analyses",
                           c("n", "Cohorts contributing"),
                           c("Varied by endpoint", join_and(per_cohort))))
  show_part(s1, "C")

  write.csv(s1,
            "../results/supplementary_tables/TableS1_cohort_composition_and_denominators.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
```

n denotes tumours, one per patient. Chen2019 is excluded from the
mutation-frequency and signature analyses because its deposited mutation file is
a curated gene list rather than a complete exome-level variant table.

# Table S2. Sensitivity analyses for hypermutation

## A. Percentage of samples flagged as hypermutated

```{r s2-a}
  title_a = "Percentage of each primary analysis cell flagged as hypermutated"
  bal = read.csv("../results/05_sensitivity/tables/01_hypermutation_balance.csv",
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  def_labels = c("mechanism (POLE/MMR/APOBEC)" =
                   "Signature mechanism (POLE/MMR/APOBEC), primary",
                 "TMB >= 10" = "TMB >= 10 mutations/Mb",
                 "TMB >= 20" = "TMB >= 20 mutations/Mb",
                 "cohort Q3 + 3 IQR" = "Cohort-specific extreme (Q3 + 3 x IQR)")
  cell_labels = c("EAS Never" = "EAS never", "EAS Ever" = "EAS ever",
                  "Western Never" = "Western never", "Western Ever" = "Western ever")

  s2 = NULL
  for (d in names(def_labels)) {
    b = bal[bal$definition == d, ]
    b = b[match(cell_levels, b$cell), ]
    header = paste0(cell_labels[b$cell], " (n = ", b$n_cell, ")")
    pct = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * b$n_flagged / b$n_cell)
    s2 = rbind(s2, long_rows("A", title_a, def_labels[[d]], header, pct))
  }
  show_part(s2, "A")
```

## B. Ancestry-by-smoking interaction after excluding hypermutated tumours

```{r s2-b}
  title_b = "Ancestry-by-smoking interaction after excluding hypermutated tumors"
  hyp = read.csv("../results/05_sensitivity/tables/03_hypermutation_sensitivity.csv",
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  scen_labels = c("full" = "Full analysis set (primary)",
                  "exclude mechanism" = "Exclude signature-mechanism flagged",
                  "exclude TMB >= 10" = "Exclude TMB >= 10 mutations/Mb",
                  "exclude TMB >= 20" = "Exclude TMB >= 20 mutations/Mb",
                  "exclude cohort extreme" = "Exclude cohort-specific extreme")
  s2b_cols = c("Analysis-set tumors remaining",
               "TMB DiD (mutations/Mb)", "TMB 95% CI",
               "SBS4 DiD (relative contribution)", "SBS4 95% CI",
               "SBS4 bootstrap P")

  for (sc in names(scen_labels)) {
    tmb = hyp[hyp$scenario == sc & hyp$feature == "TMB", ]
    sbs4 = hyp[hyp$scenario == sc & hyp$feature == "SBS4", ]
    stopifnot(nrow(tmb) == 1, nrow(sbs4) == 1)
    s2 = rbind(s2, long_rows("B", title_b, scen_labels[[sc]], s2b_cols,
                             c(tmb$n_total,
                               round(tmb$did, 3), fmt_ci(tmb$ci_low, tmb$ci_high),
                               round(sbs4$did, 3), fmt_ci(sbs4$ci_low, sbs4$ci_high),
                               fmt_p(sbs4$p_bootstrap))))
  }
  show_part(s2, "B")

  write.csv(s2, "../results/supplementary_tables/TableS2_hypermutation_sensitivity.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
```

Hypermutated tumours are flagged and retained in the primary analysis. DiD is
the smoking-associated change in Western tumours minus the corresponding change
in EAS tumours; an SBS4 DiD of 0.230 is 23.0 percentage points. The tumours
remaining are counted before endpoint-specific missingness.

# Table S3. Western cohorts' ethnicity and sensitivity to the Western-group definition

## A. Reported race or ethnicity in the two Western cohorts before exclusions

All tumours in the two Western cohorts, before any exclusion. The Asian or
part-Asian category is the reported-ancestry exclusion flag set by 00; mixed
White and Black is counted as Other.

```{r s3-a}
  title_a = "Reported race or ethnicity in the two Western cohorts before exclusions"
  race_cols = c("White", "Not reported", "Black or African American",
                "Asian or part-Asian", "Other")
  fields = c("TCGA2014" = "Self-reported race", "TRACERx2023" = "Reported ethnicity")

  # "3 Indian; 2 Middle eastern; ..." as the labels appear in the source files.
  as_reported = function(x) {
    tab = sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
    paste(paste(as.integer(tab), names(tab)), collapse = "; ")
  }

  s3 = NULL
  for (co in names(fields)) {
    info = read.csv(paste0("../data/", co, "_info.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    stopifnot(all(info$SampleID %in% meta_raw$SampleID))
    excluded = meta_raw$AncestryExcluded[match(info$SampleID, meta_raw$SampleID)]
    race = tolower(info$ReportedRace)

    category = rep("Other", nrow(info))
    category[is.na(race) | race == "not reported"] = "Not reported"
    category[grepl("black", race) & !grepl("white", race)] = "Black or African American"
    category[grepl("^white", race) & !grepl(" and ", race)] = "White"
    category[excluded] = "Asian or part-Asian"

    n_cat = table(factor(category, levels = race_cols))
    asian_text = as_reported(info$ReportedRace[category == "Asian or part-Asian"])
    other_text = as_reported(info$ReportedRace[category == "Other"])
    s3 = rbind(s3, long_rows("A", title_a, co,
                             c("Field", race_cols,
                               "Asian or part-Asian, as reported", "Other, as reported"),
                             c(fields[[co]], n_cat, asian_text, other_text)))
  }
  show_part(s3, "A")
```

## B. Ancestry-by-smoking interaction under alternative Western-group definitions

The definition-set sizes are rebuilt from the metadata with the rules used in
`05_sensitivity.Rmd` section 3 and checked against the saved table. The White
restriction there keeps every Western tumour whose reported race or ethnicity
contains "white".

`05_sensitivity.Rmd` bootstraps the primary set once in section 1 and again in
section 3; the two runs share point estimates and differ only in the
random-number stream. For TMB and SBS4, the two endpoints Table S2 reports, the
primary row repeats the Table S2B estimate so that one primary interval is
quoted across the two tables. SBS1 and C>A come from the section 3 run.

```{r s3-b}
  title_b = "Ancestry-by-smoking interaction under alternative Western-group definitions"
  anc = read.csv("../results/05_sensitivity/tables/05_ancestry_restriction.csv",
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  primary = "exclude self-reported Asian"

  for (f in c("TMB", "SBS4")) {
    swap = anc$scenario == primary & anc$feature == f
    src = hyp[hyp$scenario == "full" & hyp$feature == f, ]
    stopifnot(sum(swap) == 1, nrow(src) == 1, anc$n_total[swap] == src$n_total)
    anc$did[swap] = src$did
    anc$ci_low[swap] = src$ci_low
    anc$ci_high[swap] = src$ci_high
    anc$p_bootstrap[swap] = src$p_bootstrap
  }

  # Definition sets before endpoint-specific missingness.
  smoked = meta_raw[!is.na(meta_raw$Smoking), ]
  west_all = smoked$CohortGroup == "Western"
  west_white = west_all & grepl("white", tolower(smoked$ReportedRace))
  def_total = c("all patients" = nrow(smoked),
                "exclude self-reported Asian" = nrow(meta),
                "Western restricted to reported White" = sum(!west_all) + sum(west_white))
  def_west = c("all patients" = sum(west_all),
               "exclude self-reported Asian" = sum(meta$CohortGroup == "Western"),
               "Western restricted to reported White" = sum(west_white))

  scen_labels = c("all patients" =
                    "All patients (no race/ethnicity exclusion)",
                  "exclude self-reported Asian" =
                    "Exclude reported Asian or part-Asian (primary)",
                  "Western restricted to reported White" =
                    "Western group restricted to reported White")
  s3b_cols = c("Endpoint", "Scenario", "Definition-set n total", "Western n",
               "DiD", "95% CI", "Bootstrap P")

  for (f in c("TMB", "SBS4", "SBS1", "C>A")) {
    for (sc in names(scen_labels)) {
      r = anc[anc$feature == f & anc$scenario == sc, ]
      stopifnot(nrow(r) == 1, r$n_total == def_total[[sc]])
      s3 = rbind(s3, long_rows("B", title_b, paste0(f, ": ", scen_labels[[sc]]),
                               s3b_cols,
                               c(f, scen_labels[[sc]], r$n_total, def_west[[sc]],
                                 round(r$did, 3), fmt_ci(r$ci_low, r$ci_high),
                                 fmt_p(r$p_bootstrap))))
    }
  }
  show_part(s3, "B")

  write.csv(s3, "../results/supplementary_tables/TableS3_western_group_definition.csv",
            row.names = FALSE)
```

The four EAS cohorts carry cohort-level designations; no individual
genotype-based ancestry estimate is available. TMB is in mutations/Mb, whereas
SBS4, SBS1 and C>A are proportions.

```{r session}
  sessionInfo()
```
